page.overview:
Who is Beilert Valance's mother?

A human female was the mother of Beilert Valance. They lived with Valance and his father on Chorin where Valance's parents worked as miners. At one point, Valance's mother fixed his toy Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter after it broke, though Valance's father told them not to as it would only fill his head with dreams when he was destined to work as a miner. Valance's mother then told the boy's father to stop being a blurrg in the mud and that their son would have a childhood.

Beilert Valance's mother first appeared, in flashbacks, in the thirty-fourth issue of the 2020 comic series Star Wars: Bounty Hunters. The issue was written by Ethan Sacks, illustrated by Paolo Villanelli, and published by Marvel Comics
